title: 자기 보험
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop R&B ballad. Clean electric guitar plays jazz-influenced seventh chords with a chorus effect. A sub-heavy synth bass follows the kick drum pattern. Percussion consists of a crisp snare with short reverb, a tight kick, and sixteenth-note hi-hats. Smooth male tenor vocals utilize breathy delivery in the lower register and transition to a clear, resonant head voice. A subtle electric piano provides harmonic padding in the background. Key of E Major. Tempo is 84 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar with chorus effect, arpeggiated chords]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male tenor vocals]
미소를 연습해 [kick drum and snare enter]
커피 한잔 건네며
당신의 미래를
제가 지켜드릴게요 [sub-bass enters]
서류 위의 숫자가
안심이 되시죠
고개를 끄덕이면 계약은 완성이야 오늘도 세 번째야

[Pre-Chorus]
퇴근길 발걸음이
조용한 방을 향해
내 보험은 어디 있어 [electric piano pads enter]
창을 열었다가
또다시 한숨만 길어
남의 불안은 잘 읽어 [vocal transitions to head voice]
내 불안은 못 봐
설계사가 설계 못 해
